description: This Kotlin source file defines a REST controller for managing calendar events via HTTP API endpoints. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, listing, updating, and deleting events, interfacing with an underlying EventService.

classes.name: EventController
classes.description: REST controller handling CRUD operations for calendar events.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new event. Accepts EventRequest and returns EventResponse.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve an event by its UUID. Returns EventResponse or 404 if not found.

methods.name: listInRange
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list events overlapping a specified date range. Accepts start and end offsets and returns list of EventResponse.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing event identified by UUID with new details from EventRequest. Returns updated EventResponse or 404.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an event by its UUID. Returns 204 No Content.
